title: sealed-bundle-prefetch-and-kube-distro-shims-for-isolated-sites
author: Ava Mitchell
description:
Motivation: On some highly restricted air-gapped deployments customers reported long bootstrap windows and occasional kube-distro incompatibilities during upgrades. This PR introduces a sealed OCI bundle format (signed + atomic index) with a prefetch orchestration hook and lightweight distro shims to increase bootstrap reliability and shorten upgrade time windows.

What this does (single-string summary): Adds a sealed-bundle packager and unpacker, a prefetch job controller/script that warms a local registry mirror with signed artifacts, Helm chart knobs to opt into prefetch semantics and immutable artifact pinning, Terraform module changes to expose registry seeding variables, and minimal kube-distro compatibility shims that smooth kubelet/cri version mismatches during node join/upgrade. Includes integration tests and CI verification for bundle signatures and idempotent prefetch.

Why this is safe: The sealed bundle is opt-in; existing installer flows remain unchanged. Distro shims are additive scripts run only during preflight/upgrade phases. The Terraform and Helm changes are backward compatible defaults; enabling prefetch requires explicit flags.

Related: Linear ENG-7123 (airgap bootstrap reliability), INF-198 (registry seeding terraform work).

- add: sealed bundle packager/unpacker (packager/sealed_pack.go + tests)
- feat: prefetch orchestration job and scripts (scripts/prefetch.sh, controllers/prefetch_controller.go)

patch_snippets: installer/packager/sealed_pack.go: added SignBundle / VerifyBundle helpers (ed25519-based), index.json.atomic write path. scripts/prefetch.sh: parallel fetch with retry/backoff and local OCI push. charts/private/templates/preload-job.yaml: adds conditional .Values.prefetch.enabled block and a ttlSecondsAfterFinished=600 to avoid tight re-runs.
review_summary:
Rohan: noted a potential race in the prefetch controller when multiple nodes attempt initial seeding; asked for leader election and idempotency.
Sofia: requested explicit tests for signature verification and failure modes (corrupt index).
Liam: asked to keep default behavior off for existing customers and to add a short note in upgrade playbook.
Author responses: implemented leader election via controller-runtime leader election (controller updated), added a signature-failure integration test and doc section on troubleshooting. Addressed Helm defaults and added upgrade playbook note.
Approvals: after two follow-ups and a CI rerun approvals from Rohan and Sofia were added.
ci_log: Initial run: unit tests pass, integration prefetch tests failed (race on registry seed lock). Second run: fixed race, linter flagged unused import; fixed. Final run: all checks green (unit/integration/lint/helm-template). GitHub Actions workflow: verify-seal.yml, integration/prefetch.yml, helm/lint.yml passed.
release_notes:
- Added sealed OCI bundle format with signature verification and atomic indices (opt-in).
- Prefetch orchestration for seeding local registries to speed bootstrap/upgrade windows.
- Terraform: registry module exposes seed toggles and pre-seed credentials.
- Helm: .Values.prefetch.enabled and immutable artifact pinning options.
- Kube distro shims to reduce node-join/upgrade friction on older kubelet/cri combinations.
post_merge_tasks: Backport hooks to release/1.8.x for security patch; add entry to installer upgrade playbook; schedule SRE runbook walkthrough (INF-198 follow-up).
